fields.System.Title: OUT-205 — Re-allocate after a stock adjustment
fields.System.Description:
Story

As a picker, I want the system to notice when allocated stock disappears, so that I do
not find out by arriving at an empty shelf.

Acceptance criteria

  • - Given inventory.stock_adjusted reduces stock with reservations against it, then
  • outbound re-evaluates the affected order lines.
  • - Given alternative stock exists, then the line is re-allocated automatically and the
  • pick task updated.
  • - Given no alternative exists, then the line is flagged for a supervisor and the order
  • state reflects it.
  • - Given the pick task has already been picked, then re-allocation is not attempted and
  • the discrepancy is escalated.
  • - Given the same event delivered twice, then re-allocation happens once.

Traceability

| Aspect | Detail |
|---|---|
| Modules | outbound, inventory |
| Tables | allocation, reservation, pick_task |
| Risks | Adjustment silently invalidating an allocation ([doc 09 §4.5](../../../docs/09-defect-hotspots.md)); duplicate event ([doc 09 §3.4](../../../docs/09-defect-hotspots.md)) |
| Tests | integration · idempotency · event handling |
